messages:
ana: Uploaded a tiny Figma for the rollout timeline inspector. Main trade: fast hover peek for mouse vs explicit open for keyboard/touch. Quick takes?

mike: Hover peek is nice for scanning. We must make allocation labels explicit (users read numbers as versions). Also rollback should be reachable but behind confirmation.

sam: Technical approach: CSS hover-only preview (no focus) + JS-driven persistent inspector on Enter/click. Use aria-expanded when persistent.

yvonne: Accessibility: no hover-only content. Add aria-describedby for pills and a visually-hidden string like 'Canary variant, receiving 5% of traffic'. Increase pill contrast to >=4.5:1.

jules: Copy: change pill to 'Canary  5% of traffic  v42' (explicit units + short version tag). Keep pill text short visually, SR-only description for details.

mike: UX: show a subtle 'Undo/Revert' affordance inside the inspector (ghost button) that opens a confirmation modal. No immediate destructive clicks.

sam: CSS preview example (tiny): .rollout-node .preview{transform:translateY(-6px);opacity:0;transition:.12s} .rollout-node:hover .preview{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} Use :focus-within to show for keyboard only when node is focused, but require Enter to open persistent panel. Add 200ms hide delay so preview doesn't vanish instantly.

yvonne: For inspector semantics: if non-modal use role=region with aria-labelledby. For rollback modal use role=dialog + aria-labelledby + aria-describedby and trap focus. Return focus on close.

ana: I'll update Figma with keyboard flow, SR copy, contrast and padding fixes, and the small checklist for eng: 1) hover preview + 200ms hide (disabled on touch), 2) Enter/click opens persistent inspector (aria-expanded), 3) arrow key nav inside inspector, 4) sr-only pill descriptions, 5) revert opens confirm dialog, 6) microcopy change for allocations.

deploy-bot: Heads-up: feature flag compact-rollout-inspector will be enabled in staging tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Watch /deploys/rollout-inspector. :rocket:

mike: Close once PR links to the checklist. :thumbsup:
